items.question: What is Builder by HotCode?
items.answer: Builder by HotCode is an AI-powered website generator that turns a plain-text description of your idea into a fully functional, production-ready website in under 60 seconds. It uses GPT-4o to write clean Next.js + TypeScript code, complete with styling and responsive layouts.

items.question: How does the credit system work?
items.answer: Each website generation consumes credits from your account balance. One generation costs one credit. You can purchase credit packs starting from our Free tier (50 credits at no cost) up to our 500-credit pack. Credits never expire, so you can use them at your own pace.

items.question: What does 'production-ready' actually mean?
items.answer: Every site Builder generates is written in Next.js 14 with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS — the same stack used by professional development teams. The output is clean, linted, and structured so you can deploy it directly to Vercel, Netlify, or any Node-compatible host without modification.

items.question: Can I edit the code after it's generated?
items.answer: Absolutely. After generation you can preview the site live, then export the full source code as a ZIP. Open it in VS Code or any editor, make changes, and deploy. The code is yours — no lock-in, no proprietary format.

items.question: What AI model powers the generator?
items.answer: Builder uses OpenAI's GPT-4o model, which gives it strong reasoning about layout, component structure, and modern web best practices. We continuously fine-tune our prompting pipeline to improve output quality with every release.

items.question: Does Builder support full-stack features?
items.answer: Yes. Builder can generate API routes, server components, and data-fetching logic alongside your UI. Describe a feature like 'a contact form that sends email' and the generator will scaffold the relevant Next.js API route and front-end form together.

items.question: How do I deploy my generated website?
items.answer: Export your project as a ZIP, unzip it, run npm install, and push to GitHub. From there, connect your repo to Vercel or Netlify for a one-click deploy. Full deployment instructions are available in our Documentation.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes. Every new account starts with 50 free credits — enough to generate and experiment with up to 50 websites. No credit card required to sign up.

items.question: Can I use Builder for client projects?
items.answer: Yes. All generated code is royalty-free and you retain full ownership. You can use it for personal projects, freelance client work, or commercial products without any attribution requirement.

items.question: What happens if I run out of credits?
items.answer: When your balance reaches zero, new generations are paused. You can top up instantly by purchasing any credit pack from the Pricing page. Your existing projects and exports are never affected.

items.question: Is my data and project code kept private?
items.answer: Yes. Your prompts and generated projects are stored privately under your account and are never shared with other users or used to train AI models. You can delete any project from your dashboard at any time.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Credit packs are non-refundable once purchased, but if you experience a generation failure due to a platform error, we'll restore the spent credit automatically. If you have a billing concern, contact our support team and we'll make it right.

items.question: What browsers and devices are supported?
items.answer: The Builder dashboard works in all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) on desktop and tablet. Generated websites are fully responsive and tested across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

items.question: Is there an API I can use to integrate Builder into my own tools?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a REST API that lets you trigger generations, retrieve project files, and manage credits programmatically. Full API reference is available in our Documentation.

items.question: How do I get help if I'm stuck?
items.answer: Check our Documentation for step-by-step guides, browse the FAQ, or reach out via the Contact page. We typically respond within one business day.
